title: Coverage-Year Accounting Note: The Allowance Entries Counted When Coverage Passes On
content:
When coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans passes to a new owner, the allowance entries that count toward the benefit standing on the plan are those falling in a period fixed by whether the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and by what the allowance entries themselves show.

Where the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and an allowance entry stands on the plan inside the coverage year in progress, the allowance entries counted are those booked inside that coverage year. Where the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and no allowance entry stands on the plan inside the coverage year in progress, the allowance entries counted are those booked in the 12 months to the handling date. In any other case the allowance entries counted are those booked over the whole time the plan has been in force.

## Which entries are counted

| The coverage grants its allowance afresh each year | Allowance entries inside the coverage year in progress | The allowance entries counted |
|---|---|---|
| yes | one or more | those booked inside that coverage year |
| yes | none | those booked in the 12 months to the handling date |
| no | any | those booked over the whole time the plan has been in force |

The coverage year in progress runs from the anniversary of the day coverage began, and its months so far are the whole months since coverage began beyond the coverage years already completed.

## Which plans grant afresh

| Plan | The yearly allowance is granted afresh each year |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | no |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | yes |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | yes |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | yes |
